requirement: v3.2.2: fix the v3.2.1 regression where the decision-inbox/queue-journal overlay locked the whole client (hidden attribute lost to an author display rule), and give the queue journal the persistent surfaces it lacked (right-edge floating badge + drawer, GPW button, always-visible composer dock chip), proven in a real DSH page

assertions.badge: a fixed right-edge 队列 badge below the inbox badge shows the number of saved journals and opens a drawer
assertions.drawer: the drawer lists every saved journal newest-first with session key, update time, draft preview and per-row queued messages; each row restores the draft into the composer, restores the queue through POST /api/w2m/composer/queue (reporting session-not-live honestly) or clears the record; nothing is sent automatically
assertions.dock: the composer dock no longer disappears when empty: it carries a 队列日志 chip that opens the drawer (the original Fang component returned null)
assertions.gpw: the GPW panel header carries a 队列 N button next to the inbox button, opening the same drawer
assertions.data: GET /api/w2m/composer/journal?list=1 lists entries, POST /api/w2m/composer/journal clears one, POST /api/w2m/composer/queue restores queued messages; the drawer refreshes on open and every 8s
assertions.id: the composer dock registration id is w2m-queue-journal so it cannot collide with a simultaneously installed Fang queue-journal plugin
assertions.proof: real Chromium page probe: POST and GET journal routes answer 200, the badge is in the DOM, a click opens the drawer whose title names 队列日志 and whose body contains the draft that was just saved, and the GPW panel contains the queue button; the conversation-scoped dock chip is reported as a diagnostic
assertions.suites: queue-journal 4/4; client-bundle 36/36; loader-entry 10/10 with both probes; claims and layer model green
assertions.remaining: not yet ported from Fang: drawer keyboard navigation, batch restore, per-session filtering and grouped history snapshots
assertions.overlay_lock: the overlay and drawer toggle style.display instead of the hidden attribute, a [hidden]{display:none!important} rule backs it up, and the browser probe asserts the closed drawer/overlay compute to display:none and that elementFromPoint at the page centre is not inside the overlay
